graph/description:
**DESI's standard ruler.** Sound waves frozen into matter 380,000 years after the Big Bang left a preferred galaxy separation, $r_d \approx 147$ Mpc. DESI measures it across the line of sight, $D_M/r_d$, and along it, $D_H/r_d$ with $D_H = c/H(z)$, at seven redshifts.

Each is shown divided by what ΛCDM (fitted to DESI and the CMB) predicts: on the line at 1 is ΛCDM. The dashed curves are the evolving dark energy fitted to all three rulers.

Watch $z \approx 0.5$–$0.7$: $D_H$ below 1 means the expansion was a little faster there than ΛCDM allows.

**Hover** a point.
